title: Oseberg ship and burial assemblage

date.label: Ship built before its use in the 834 CE burial

discovery.note: Excavation of the Oseberg mound exposed the ship, two women, and extensive grave goods.

summary: The ship and associated grave goods form the material core of the Oseberg burial context.
uncertainty: The material assemblage does not by itself establish the two women's exact identities or specific cultic roles.
